scope: public-literature triage for Gate 9 and later model-comparison planning
inclusion_rules: primary research paper or official institutional record of a primary paper
direct relevance to CO2 depressurization, two-phase acoustics, equilibrium/relaxation models, or robust compressible multiphase numerics
model, numerical method, or validation evidence sufficiently specified to map to the FVM project
exclusion_rules: secondary summaries used as the only evidence source
papers unrelated to compressible phase-changing flow
methods requiring immediate production changes before Gate 9 forensic evidence exists
search_topics: CO2 pipeline depressurization HEM sound velocity discontinuity
CO2 pipeline homogeneous relaxation delayed phase transition
CO2 pipeline non-equilibrium two-fluid experimental validation
two-phase relaxation subcharacteristic condition sound speed
homogeneous equilibrium model Roe preconditioning arbitrary EOS
compressible two-phase WENO positivity hyperbolicity preserving

papers.title: Depressurization of carbon dioxide in pipelines—Models and methods
papers.gate9_use: Direct precedent for separating numerical-method accuracy from discontinuous acoustic closure effects.

papers.title: A homogeneous relaxation flow model for the full bore rupture of dense phase CO2 pipelines
papers.venue: International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control 17, 349-356
papers.gate9_use: Supports retaining finite-rate phase change as a later comparison model rather than interpreting all Gate 8 sensitivity as numerical error.

papers.title: Modelling the non-equilibrium two-phase flow during depressurisation of CO2 pipelines
papers.venue: International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control 30, 9-18
papers.gate9_use: Defines a later HEM-versus-non-equilibrium validation branch and cautions against long-duration HEM approval.

papers.title: Numerical Simulation of the Homogeneous Equilibrium Model for Two-Phase Flows
papers.gate9_use: Directly motivates recording acoustic branch and local Mach stiffness before changing the solver.

papers.title: A Hierarchy of Relaxation Models for Two-Phase Flow
papers.gate9_use: Provides a model-level acoustic consistency check for future offline reference calculations.

papers.title: Depressurization of CO2-rich mixtures in pipes: Two-phase flow modelling and comparison with experiments
papers.venue: International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control 37, 398-411
papers.gate9_use: Balances the literature: HEM can remain useful for some cases, so model escalation must be evidence- and case-specific.

papers.title: Modelling phase transition in metastable liquids: application to cavitating and flashing flows
papers.gate9_use: Supports a future metastability/finite-rate comparison after the unchanged HEM forensic gate.

papers.title: Wave Propagation in Multicomponent Flow Models
papers.gate9_use: Reference for checking whether a relaxed mixture sound speed is physically ordered relative to a less-relaxed model.

papers.title: On the effect of temperature and velocity relaxation in two-phase flow models
papers.venue: ESAIM: Mathematical Modelling and Numerical Analysis 46(2), 411-442
papers.gate9_use: Shows that equilibrium assumptions can materially alter sonic propagation even when bulk mass transport changes little.

papers.title: A two-fluid four-equation model with instantaneous thermodynamical equilibrium
papers.venue: ESAIM: Mathematical Modelling and Numerical Analysis 50(4), 1167-1192
papers.gate9_use: Motivates an offline model-intrinsic acoustic reference rather than relying solely on a finite-difference property probe.

papers.title: Two-Phase Flow of CO2 with Phase Transfer
papers.gate9_use: Provides a concrete finite-rate phase-transfer architecture suitable for later comparison.

papers.title: Modeling of the two-phase flow during depressurization of liquified CO2 in a pipe
papers.gate9_use: Candidate later high-resolution comparison; not an authorization to change the Gate 9 baseline.

papers.title: Positivity Preservation of a First-Order Scheme for a Quasi-Conservative Compressible Two-Material Model
papers.venue: SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 43(4), B1029-B1055
papers.gate9_use: Later robustness reference if evidence shows the accepted-state path approaches a non-hyperbolic or nonphysical region.

papers.title: An incremental-stencil WENO reconstruction for simulation of compressible two-phase flows
papers.gate9_use: Later numerical-improvement candidate after first-order flux and acoustic contributions are diagnosed.
